query:
query Query($customerId: String) {
 loyaltyMemberAccount(customerId: $customerId) {
 customerId 
 byDate 
 retainPointTotal 
 rollingPointTotal 
 totalVsflownMiles 
 tierStartDate 
 tierEndDate 
 numberofYearsAtGold 
 totalVSTierPointsInCurrentYear 
 totalVSTierPointsSinceBecomingGold 
 tierPointsForRetainToSilver  
 tierPointsForRetainToGold  
 tierPointsForRedToSilver 
 tierPointsForSilverToGold 
 wingsStartDate 
 totalTierPointsSinceBecomingWings 
 totalVSTierPointsSinceBecomingWings 
 goldStartDate 
 }
}
